stories.title: Midgardr - Official Trailer | Out of Bounds Showcase 2026 - IGN
stories.summary: Check out the trailer for Midgardr, an upcoming board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems. Will your village thrive… or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?Midgardr will be available on PC on January 8, 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.

stories.title: Infamous Keepers - Official Trailer | Out of Bounds Showcase 2026 - IGN
stories.summary: Get another look at Infamous Keepers through the eyes of the Janitor who cleans up the bloody mess left behind after battles. Infamous Keepers is a tower defense/tactical roguelite set in the Legend of Keepers universe, where you play as a Dungeon Keeper. Infamous Keepers will be available on PC.In Infamous Keepers, defend your dungeon and your job! Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

stories.title: Blade and Madness - Official Gameplay Trailer | Out of Bounds Showcase 2026 - IGN
stories.summary: Check out gameplay from Blade and Madness in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite deckbuilder where turns play out simultaneously and every choice matters. As madness creeps in, your cards change, the battlefield twists, and enemies grow more unpredictable. Adaptation isn’t optional, it’s the only way to survive… or give in to the dark. Blade and Madness will be available on Steam.In Blade and Madness, something malevolent has dragged your ship onto shattered shores, to a place in the Atlantic whose name has been forgotten by the rest of the Old World. An island infested with horrors, from which you will have to somehow escape.
